summary: Sanders County L-4 timber tower on Loveland Peak, built 1934 and destroyed in 1960; no source describes what remains at the site today.

facts.design: L-4 cab on a 50-foot pole tower
facts.status_note: Destroyed in 1960 per firelookout.com and Forest Lookouts; no source describes remains at the site

events.note: Destroyed in 1960; Forest Lookouts adds that it was toppled and burned

evidence.quote: This 50' pole L-4 tower, built in 1934, was destroyed in 1960.

evidence.supports: built 1934; 50-foot timber tower with L-4 cab
evidence.quote: 1934: A 50-foot native timber tower with a L-4 cab was constructed.
1960: The tower was toppled and burned.

evidence.supports: Loveland Peak is in Sanders County; status gone
forests listed as Cabinet, Kaniksu and Kootenai

resolved_conflicts.explanation: firelookout.com lists the Cabinet, Kaniksu and Kootenai National Forests together; Forest Lookouts names only the Kootenai National Forest. The record's Kootenai National Forest entry is kept because both sources include it.

notes_for_editor: Both pages agree on 1934 and 1960. No source read describes the site today, any staffing, or access. A search also returned a Sanders County page on firelookout.com (mtsanders.html) that was not read. Nothing checked on the ground.
